## Default Permission

Allows FoxChat remote-push registration, notification updates, and native crypto diagnostics.

#### This default permission set includes the following:

- `allow-get-token`
- `allow-request-permission`
- `allow-clear-room-notification`
- `allow-update-notification`
- `allow-sync-native-crypto`
- `allow-native-crypto-status`
- `allow-test-native-crypto`
- `allow-test-android-auto-notification`
